# JHPCE (Johns Hopkins Joint High Performance Computing Exchange)

> > JHPCE is Johns Hopkins' high-performance computing cluster supporting biomedical research with SLURM job scheduling, secure data enclaves (C-SUB, JADE), and NIST 800-171 compliance for CMS healthcare data.

The JHPCE cluster provides computational infrastructure for Johns Hopkins researchers with specialized environments including the C-SUB secure subcluster and JADE cluster for CUI-compliant healthcare research. The platform supports standard scientific software (R, Python, SAS, Matlab) and provides comprehensive storage, data transfer, and job scheduling capabilities through SLURM.

## Key Topics

- SLURM job scheduling
- JADE cluster (secure CUI environment)
- C-SUB secure subcluster
- NIST 800-171 compliance
- CMS healthcare data
- Storage quotas and ZFS
- SFTP and secure data transfer
- MobaXterm SSH access
- Scientific computing (R, Python, SAS, Matlab)
- Cluster storage management
- Two-factor authentication
- HPC resource allocation
- File transfer security
- CUI compliance requirements

## Getting Started

- [New User Onboarding](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/joinus): New user onboarding guide with pricing, compute charges, and access info
- [FAQ](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/help/faq): Frequently asked questions about SLURM, file transfer, and cluster basics
- [Password Reset and Two-Factor Authentication](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/help/password): Password reset and Google Authenticator two-factor authentication setup
- [Grant and Acknowledgment Text](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/aboutus/GrantAndAckBlurbs): Grant submission and acknowledgment text for JHPCE HPC infrastructure

## Secure Computing Environments

- [C-SUB Secure Subcluster](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/csub/csub-overview): C-SUB secure subcluster for CMS healthcare data research and compliance
- [JADE Cluster Data Transfer](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/jade/access/transfer-overview): JADE cluster data transfer overview with SFTP and CUI compliance details
- [JADE Migration Guide for CMS Users](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/jade/transition/cms-transition): JADE cluster migration guide for CMS users transitioning from C-SUB
- [MobaXterm Access to JADE](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/jade/access/mobaxterm-jade): MobaXterm SSH access guide for JADE cluster (placeholder page)
- [Filesystem Encryption with ENCFS](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/files/encfs): ENCFS filesystem encryption setup guide with FUSE and AES encryption

## Storage and Data Management

- [Storage Overview](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/storage): Overview of JHPCE storage systems, quotas, and data management policies
- [Storage Tips](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/storage/storage-tips): Linux storage tips including disk usage, ZFS compression, and du commands
- [OneDrive via rclone](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/access/onedrive): rclone configuration guide for OneDrive access with OAuth setup

## SLURM Job Scheduling

- [sacct Command Tips](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/slurm/tips-sacct): SLURM sacct command examples for job accounting and resource monitoring
- [SLURM Job States Reference](https://jhpce.jhu.edu/slurm/includes/all-job-states): Complete Slurm job states reference from SchedMD documentation
